name: Ashley St. Clair
bio: Ashley St. Clair (born July 31, 1998) is an American influencer, author, and political commentator. She was an outspoken proponent of conservative and anti-transgender politics. However, after having a child with Elon Musk, in 2026, St. Clair denounced her previous anti-trans activism. St. Clair later joined the Democratic Socialists of America.

credits.title: Musk
credits.overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.
